name.ja: Figure-rise Standard 1/12 ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.3(FULLY ARMED)
name.en: Figure-rise Standard 1/12 ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.3(FULLY ARMED)

ja: 『ULTRAMAN』より「ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.3(FULLY ARMED)」が、Figure-rise Standardに登場！
• 本体の赤色はグロスインジェクション、銀色はエクストラフィニッシュでボディ表面の質感を再現！
• 胸部に収めることができるLEDユニットが付属し、目を発光させることができる。
• 新規のWIDE SHOT、EX-RIFLEに加えて、二刀流を再現できるSPECIUM SWORDが２本付属。
EX-RIFLEはホビー事業部オリジナルの銃身拡張パーツ付。
• 原作者・清水栄一氏によるオリジナルデザインの武器EYE SLUGGERが付属。
en: "ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.3 (FULLY ARMED)" from " ULTRAMAN" is now available in Figure-rise Standard!
• The red color of the main body is gloss injection, and the silver color is extra finish to reproduce the texture of the body surface!
• Comes with an LED unit that can be placed in the chest, allowing the eyes to emit light.
• In addition to the new WIDE SHOT and EX-RIFLE, two SPECIUM SWORDs that can reproduce dual wielding are included.
EX-RIFLE comes with barrel extension parts original to the Hobby Division.
• Comes with the original designed weapon EYE SLUGGER by the original author, Eiichi Shimizu.

ja: オリジナル武器EX-RIFLE拡張バレル×2
en: Original weapon EX-RIFLE expansion barrel x 2
